name: The Loyalist
tagline: The Loyal Skeptic or the Trooper

items.label: Center of intelligence
items.value: Mental (Head).

children.label: Repressed center
children.value: Mental: the paradox of the 6 — over-analyzes yet doesn't trust its own inner guidance.

items.label: Direction of use
items.value: Inward and outward: seeks a balance between its own understanding and external rules.

items.label: Central issue
items.value: Anxiety and a lack of support or guidance.

sections.title: Ego dynamics
sections.desc: Compulsion, passion, fixation, defense, pride, fear, desire.

items.label: Compulsion (Avoidance)
items.value: Avoid deviance at all costs: stepping outside the framework, the rules, or the group's protection.

items.label: Passion (Vice)
items.value: Fear: chronic anxiety, apprehension about the future.

items.label: Fixation
items.value: Doubt / suspicion: questions others' motives and its own decisions.

items.label: Defense mechanism
items.value: Projection: attributing to others its own unacceptable fears/anger/motives in order to justify mistrust.

items.label: Egotic pride
items.value: I am loyal, I do my duty.

items.label: Basic fear
items.value: Being without support or guidance, alone and unable to survive.

items.label: Basic desire
items.value: Finding security and support.

children.label: Self-preservation
children.value: Warmth: friendly, gentle, vulnerable — disarming aggression and attracting protectors.

children.label: Social
children.value: Duty: scrupulously follows rules, laws, and systems (ideologies) to feel secure.

children.label: One-to-one (Sexual)
children.value: Strength / beauty (counterphobic): intimidates so as not to be intimidated; uses strength or charm to test and secure the bond.

items.label: Social style
items.value: Compliant / dutiful: approaches people according to the dictates of the superego and the group.

items.label: Conflict management
items.value: Reactive: reacts intensely to stress, needs others to validate the anxiety or the grievances.

items.label: Wings
items.value: Wing 5 (introverted, secretive, intellectual) and wing 7 (extroverted, sociable, avoids anxiety through activity).

items.label: Integration (Growth)
items.value: → 9: more serene, relaxed, trusting, grounded.

items.label: Disintegration (Stress)
items.value: → 3: hyperactive, competitive, preoccupied with an image of success to mask insecurity.

sections.title: Spiritual identity and core
sections.desc: Holy Idea, virtue, aspect, core, child of the soul.

items.label: Holy Idea
items.value: Holy Faith and Holy Strength: the certainty that Essence exists within oneself and supports reality.

items.label: Virtue
items.value: Courage: acting despite fear, grounded in inner guidance.

items.label: Idealized aspect
items.value: Personal Will (White / Silver): a solid, indestructible inner support.

children.label: Specific difficulty
children.value: Fearful insecurity / castration: the feeling of being cut off from one's foundation.

children.label: Specific reaction
children.value: Defensive suspicion: staying on guard to anticipate danger.

children.label: Specific illusion
children.value: Cynicism: believing humans are fundamentally selfish and that support is impossible.

items.label: Child of the soul
items.value: The inner little 9: wants peace/fusion, frightened by instability.

items.label: Speaking style
items.value: Limits / "Yes, but…": caution, constant second-guessing, verbal procrastination.

items.label: Communication misunderstanding
items.value: Caution-Negativity: realistic warnings perceived as pessimism or hostility.

sections.title: Evolution and relationships
sections.desc: Warning signs, growth practices, confusions, interactions.

items.label: Warning signs
items.value: Catastrophic scenarios, paranoia, aggressive tests of loyalty.

items.label: Growth practices
items.value: Return to physical sensations, recognize projections, act without waiting to be 100% sure.

items.label: Common confusions
items.value: 1 (rules), 4 (anxiety/emotions), 8 (if counterphobic), 9 (if phobic).

children.label: In love
children.value: Very loyal and protective (us against the world); can be smothering out of a need for reassurance.

children.label: At work
children.value: Devoted, forward-thinking collaborator; struggles to make risky decisions without hierarchical approval.

levels.text: Valiant hero: inner faith, quiet courage, rightful commitment.
Engaged friend: loyalty, reliability, protection of the bond.
Cooperative worker: sense of duty, team spirit, steadiness.
Worried loyalist: heightened vigilance, rumination, need for guarantees.
Ambivalent pessimist: doubt, mistrust, oscillation, testing.
Panicked dependent: frantic search for support, submission/attachment.
Paranoid hysteric: threat everywhere, extreme reactions.

items.label: Consciousness
items.value: Moving from anxious vigilance to self-remembering and faith in one's own strength.

items.label: Spiral Dynamics
items.value: BLUE (order, loyalty, discipline) and sometimes PURPLE (tribal security).

items.label: Analogy
items.value: A high-frequency radar: scans the horizon for storms, forgetting that the ship's hull (Essence) is unsinkable.
